mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, which increase the risk of amiodarone-induced torsades de pointes and other ventricular arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels closely; maintain K+ >4.0 mEq/L and Mg2+ >2.0 mg/dL; consider potassium-sparing agent or alternative diuretic; monitor ECG for QT prolongation.
